//: EAS build profiles for AgroFlow.
WHY `preview` BUILDS AN APK AND `production` DOES NOT:
EAS defaults an Android build to an .aab (Android App Bundle), which is
what Google Play requires and what nothing else can install. A farmer
cannot sideload an .aab, and neither can a lecturer marking this. So
`preview` sets buildType: apk - a single file that installs by tapping
it - and `production` keeps the .aab for the day this reaches Play.
`development` exists because expo-video is a NATIVE module: Expo Go
cannot load it, so testing the loading animation needs a development
build rather than the usual `npx expo start`.
Run the installable one with:
npx eas build -p android --profile preview
It needs an Expo login, so it is NOT run from here.
BEFORE THE FIRST BUILD, set these two as EAS secrets - the app throws at
startup without them (lib/supabase.ts), so the APK would install and then
immediately fail:
npx eas secret:create --name EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL --value <url>
npx eas secret:create --name EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY --value <key>
They are secrets rather than values in this file only because this file
is committed; the publishable key is safe to expose in the built app, which
is what RLS is for.
